argv: view export dataset 134 --yes --input '{"dataset_name": "ILG sim send typed", "target_project_id": 57}'
detail: Cross-project branch-out: view 134 (project 58, dataset 112) -> new dataset 114 in project 57; export listed on the source view as handler internal_dataset, trigger pipeline, status executed, TARGET_DS_ID 114, project_id 57. Earlier raw run (dataset 113) was refreshed 302 -> 301 rows after a filter was added upstream, so the send is a persistent pipeline step, not a snapshot. Requires SDK 0.7.13 target_project_id (adds USER_ID + export_project/project_id/source_project_id).
